access_boundary: This record represents the Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live variant of the Gemini 3.5 Transcribe line, generally available August 26, 2026 with no shutdown date announced and documented through the unary gemini-3.5-transcribe model page. The unary variant, the live translate and Flash Live lines, and later Gemini releases remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google documents the model page, GA changelog entry, and a dedicated live-transcription guide
The published limit is a 10-minute audio duration per live session rather than a token context
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The release is served only through the Live API surface
